_notes: Videos must be verified public HTTPS URLs for the EXACT NEOLINE model, no guesses or stock videos.
For English/Hebrew/Arabic, English-language Facebook clips are prioritized in the main embedded player. Russian view prioritizes Russian clips.

Only real Facebook URLs belong in 'videos'; English manufacturer instruction pages (not videos) may be placed in 'guides'.
Facebook blocks automated access without a suitable account or API authorization: do not invent Reel IDs. There are currently no verified direct Facebook video links.
